text:
lina: heads-up: after merging cust-saffron LoRA into staging I ran the invoice quick-smoke on int4 and noticed systematic rounding up on cent values (e.g. .01 -> .03). attaching tiny repro below.

noah: can you paste the minimal output snippet?

lina: sure:
```
cmd: python eval_pack/run_smoke.py --model saffron-lora-int4 --dataset samples/invoices/rounding.jsonl --metrics amount_rmse
# outputs
{\"id\":\"S-001\",\"pred\":\"$14.03\",\"gold\":\"$14.01\"}
{\"id\":\"S-007\",\"pred\":\"$200.02\",\"gold\":\"$200.00\"}
{\"id\":\"S-010\",\"pred\":\"$0.00\",\"gold\":\"$0.00\"}
```

raj: interesting that zeros are stable again. did you run the same pack with fp16?

lina: fp16 baseline is clean; only int4 shows the +0.01-+0.03 bias.

noah: any recent changes to decode or token normalization in the repo?

raj: checked the MR 19 1F; LoRA only. Runtime change last week enabled a fast fused attention kernel for int4 on certain cards. could be a kernel-decoding interaction.

lina: quick ablation plan: (1) int4 + disable kv-cache, (2) int4 + force legacy attention kernel, (3) int4 with temperature 0.0.

bench-bot: scheduled job qb-3876543210-ablation: tags [cust-saffron,int4-rounding], ETA 6m

lina: results: kv-cache off -> no significant change. forcing legacy attention kernel -> bias gone on sample set. temp 0.0 -> reduces variance but bias persists.

noah: sounds like quantized attention kernel is nudging numeric token logits. short-term mitigation: pin saffron rollouts to legacy attn on Dedicated and add an eval assertion for cent-level tolerance in the quick-eval.

raj: agree. I'll open an infra issue to add numeric-token calibration tests for new kernels. also adding a deterministic postprocess in the eval that canonicalizes cents to 2-dec places to avoid flaky matches while we triage.

qa-bot: blocking deploy: "numeric-regression" check failed for repo redwood/cust-saffron -> requires manual review.

lina: PR opened with the eval assertion and onboarding note: https://git.internal/redwood/cust-saffron/merge-requests/12. assigning to @raj for kernel triage.

noah: thanks. small follow-up: can we run token-entropy comparison for digit tokens across fp16/int4-legacy/int4-fast? might reveal softmax smoothing.

raj: queued, expect plots in ~20m. will paste link when done.

lina: great catch everyone. adding playbook note to pin legacy kernel for Saffron until we verify the fast kernel with numeric calibration. :memo:
